# Families of geoops and xrops

<!-- Generated by scripts/family_parity.py; do not edit by hand. -->

geoops and xrops are organised in families. A family name used by both means the same job on either lane (geostack gate D1); the shared ones are listed first, with that job.

| Family | Shared job | geoops | xrops |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geom` | geometry: CRS and reprojection, subsetting and cropping, mosaics, rasterize and vectorize (geoops also keeps its gradient operators here; xrops's are `xrops.grad`) | Geometry, projection, tiling, mosaicking, rasterization, and vectorization | Geometry — CRS, footprints, mosaics, vector/raster bridge, subsetting, regions |
| `learn` | scikit-learn estimators fitted and applied on the lane's carrier (GeoArray; DataArray, Dataset and DataTree) | scikit-learn integration for GeoArray operator pipelines | scikit-learn on xarray: Datasets, DataTrees and the `.sklearn` accessor |
| `mask` | masks: land, ocean and country masks, region masks, and applying a mask | Geometry masks, morphological cleanup, mask algebra, and mask application | Masks — land/ocean/country masks, mask application, and canonical regimes |
| `viz` | visualization: colormaps, composites and display panels | Visualization Operators for RGB composites, display stretching, and overlays | Visualization operators for xrops |
| `anomaly` |  | — | Anomalies — climatologies, mean removal, and anomaly calculation |
| `atm` |  | — | Atmospheric physics operators |
| `augment` |  | Remote-sensing-safe data augmentations | — |
| `budgets` |  | — | Conservation-budget diagnostics — V4.2 / V4.3 |
| `cf` |  | — | CF conventions — coordinate validation, time decoding, and renaming |
| `compositing` |  | Explicit compositing operators for co-registered GeoArray stacks | — |
| `einx` |  | `geoops.einx` — universal tensor notation over GeoArray carriers | — |
| `extremes` |  | — | Extreme-value helpers — block maxima/minima, peaks-over-threshold, point processes |
| `feature` |  | Sparse feature, edge, texture, and Hough operators | — |
| `grad` |  | — | Finite-difference calculus on labeled xarray grids |
| `indices` |  | Spectral indices for remote sensing | — |
| `inference` |  | — | Inference operators — wrap trained models as Layer-1 Operators |
| `interpolate` |  | — | Value resampling — gap-fill, regrid, coarsen, refine, bin, resample, smooth |
| `io` |  | Reader and writer operators for geospatial rasters | — |
| `matched_filter` |  | Composable pure-NumPy matched-filter operators | — |
| `measure` |  | Measurement operators for labels, regions, contours, and transects | — |
| `metrics` |  | — | Evaluation metrics, grouped by scientific diagnostic family |
| `normalize` |  | Normalization operators for remote-sensing GeoArrays | — |
| `ocn` |  | — | Oceanography physics operators |
| `plume` |  | Trace-gas plume detection, footprints, and emission estimators | — |
| `qa` |  | QA bit decoding, SCL classes, and sensor mask presets | — |
| `radiometry` |  | Sensor-agnostic radiometric transforms | — |
| `restore` |  | Restoration primitives and Operators for imperfect remote-sensing data | — |
| `segment` |  | Segmentation operators backed by :mod:`skimage.segmentation` | — |
| `spectral` |  | Band-space operators for spectral remote-sensing workflows | — |
| `transforms` |  | — | Generic transforms — Fourier, wavelet, DCT, and learned decompositions |
| `utils` |  | — | Cross-cutting utilities — domain-agnostic helpers reused across modules |
| `wavelets` |  | — | Wavelets — 1-D/2-D transforms, spectra, significance, along-track band-pass |
